# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Proposed Sanitized Future Author Inputs

Status: **proposal only; not owner-approved; not dispatchable**

## Candidate Inputs After Owner Closure

The smallest plausible implementation-blind packet would contain exact,
content-bound versions of:

1. an owner-approved successor of [`SCOPE_BRIEF.md`](SCOPE_BRIEF.md);
2. an owner-approved conventions/ownership extract containing only absolute
   iteration/restart identity, requested/effective/realized separation,
   adjacent-package boundaries, and approved terminology;
3. exact owner decision records for ODQ-001 through the route, state, response,
   stopping, uncertainty, restart, and product gates selected as necessary;
4. an owner-approved, implementation-free statement of the selected recurrence:
   the recovered baseline if preserved, an exact proof/validity statement if
   reformulated equivalently, or an intentional-new-method rationale and
   compatibility statement;
5. the owner-approved comparative-quality framework and a future
   owner-approved ODQ-001F architecture defining when the exact historical
   control, profile, metric estimators, protected dimensions, tolerances,
   improvement threshold, validity domain, uncertainty, population split,
   condition distribution/weighting, tail/stratum/outcome-fraction and

6. if an empirical lane is approved, an owner-approved sanitized qualified-
   method record or records binding `K=(M,P,S,Q,D,H,Pi,E)`, paired baseline-
   relative and absolute results, their scientific conclusions, applicability,
   compatibility, fallback, limitations, and forbidden claims without

7. exact frozen SCI-MAP and SCI-JINC boundary extracts for each owner-admitted

8. exact frozen SCI-PTC ownership/admission boundary required by an admitted

9. the approved SCI-NOI fixed-state/successor/replay boundary;
10. the exact SCI-FLT-FIXED boundary only if that route is owner-admitted;
11. a future exact approved FLT-MATCHED boundary only if that package first gains
   its own authority and the FRUIT owner then admits the route; and
12. a supersession cover stating that packet-local owner choices govern any
   conflict with older scope or coordination records.

Every admitted object must have an exact path/ref, byte size, SHA-256, role,
allowed claim, and conflict order in a future `AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md`.

## Explicit Exclusions

The author must not inspect:

- [`PRIOR_WORK.md`](PRIOR_WORK.md) or [`INTERNAL_DOSSIER.md`](INTERNAL_DOSSIER.md);
- current or historical code, configuration, schemas, tests, debug notes, or
  implementation docs;
- audit reports, findings, repairs, handoffs, ledgers, or production history;
- `validation/fruit_loop_*`, `tools/fruit_loops/`, numerical trajectories,
  plots, thresholds, calibration results, or Unity material;
- provisional SCI-FLT-MATCHED study content, unless a later approved authority
  supplies a sanitized exact boundary and the FRUIT owner admits it; or
- any frozen package files not explicitly listed in the exact packet.

## Author Stop Rule

If exact admitted sources do not determine an estimand, equation, normalization,
state transition, response, uncertainty, validity, failure, or prediction, the
author returns one precise scientific question and stops. The author must not
consult excluded sources, infer current behavior, or choose a default.

## Promotion Gate

This proposal becomes a real author packet only after scientific-owner approval
of the exact scope and decision records, conflict review, exact-byte manifest
generation, byte verification, and an explicit Stage B launch action. None has
occurred in this Stage A revision.
